content.text:
Built **RAGE QUIT //**, a playable desktop-first roguelike deckbuilder set in a fictional chatroom.

- Play cards to raise opponents’ tilt while managing your focus and energy.
- Clear three encounters, then draft a card to improve your deck between rooms.
- Includes a live chat feed, opponent intents, deck viewer, rules panel, run stats, and win/loss screens.

Open `index.html` in a browser to play. I verified the page renders in Chromium and checked `game.js` syntax. Assumption: the trolling is fictional, playful banter—not interaction with real users or servers.
